customManagers.description: Track container image versions in Pulumi stack configs

packageRules.description: No auto-merge for image updates until a black-box test is a required check and the release-age window applies (owner decision, homelab#100)

agentic-office hub: new releases are frequent and should be installed soon, automatically. Merging deploys it; a bad release is undone by reverting the tag. After the rollout the smoke job of deploy-apps.yml checks the hub (there is no black-box test before the merge yet: homelab#100)
